name: fi-employer-payroll
description: Prepare ordinary Finnish employer payroll for tax year 2026, including wage classification, tax-card ceilings, fringe-benefit valuation, employee deductions, employer contributions, Incomes Register reporting and corrections. Covers private-sector employees, working owners and insurance eligibility screens; separates TyEL pensions, unemployment, health, accident and group-life cover. Use for Finnish payslips, cash plus benefits, payroll taxes, salary reporting, employer's separate report, contribution bases and missing tax cards. Includes current statutory and annual-decision sources, payment deadlines, late-reporting consequences and two executable examples. Pension contributions for entrepreneurs are computed in the linked YEL skill; international coverage requires the actual A1 or applicable-law decision.
